title: New in Symfony 8.2: Proving Authentication Methods
content:
<html><head></head><body>The new sudo mode of Symfony 8.2 checks when users last entered their
credentials. Some applications also need to know how they did it: a password
is fine to read your invoices, but sending money may require a hardware security
key. This post explains how…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
